cohort: 160 nulliparous pregnant women were randomly divided into two groups (control and test) for the study.
finding: Self-efficacy-based counseling significantly reduced the mean fear of delivery and significantly increased the mean self-efficacy score in the test group compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The intervention aimed to reduce the fear of natural delivery, which is noted as a reason women are forced to ask for cesarean section, implicitly supporting natural delivery.
